summary_convention: Median over four predetermined reference-state samples. Ranges are min/max over states, not confidence intervals. Same eight output directions for all states/backends per field/band.

gradient_data.method: Eight orthonormal DCT-II output cotangents per field/band. Pull back through eight uncorrected solver intervals in training-RMS-normalized coordinates. Project input velocity gradients onto divergence-free zero-normal-face tangent; scalar input gradients remain free. SVD of eight resulting gradients gives sampled adjoint gain and conditioning.
limitations: Sampled eight-dimensional restriction, not full Jacobian condition or neural-parameter conditioning.
Input tangent includes scalar variations; CNN itself changes only velocity.
State samples follow each backend restricted fine reference, not learned model or training trajectory.
Frame0 is at zero velocity where discretizations can have nonsmooth derivatives; all fixed-epsilon discrepancies are retained.
Float32 API; singular values below1e-6 of largest are marked unresolved, not replaced by an epsilon floor.
Descriptive pairing with full-rollout spectral error changes; no causal attribution.
